> DigitalOcean App Platform is a fine PaaS for simple apps and static sites.

It gets restrictive when you need shell access, custom runtime tweaks, or several services that each become a separate billed add-on. The strongest DigitalOcean App Platform alternative isn't another PaaS. It's a managed server that keeps the git-push deploy, hands you shell access, and puts your databases, storage, load balancer, and cron in one dashboard.
